corrected_value.title: Improvements in problem behavior in a child with autism spectrum diagnosis through synthesized analysis and treatment: A replication in an EIBI home program.

decisions.quote:
Although this study replicated the results of previous
studies (e.g., Strand and Eldevik 2018) limitations can
be noted.
decisions.reason: The discussion compares the independently treated EIBI participant with Strand and Eldevik (2018) and expressly states that their results were replicated. The reference identifies DOI 10.1002/bin.1505. The shipped DOI 10.1002/jaba.106 identifies Hanley et al. (2014), a distinct prior paper, as confirmed by Crossref metadata. Parent reviewed the cited results/purpose and reference identity against all supplied shipped originals. This decision confirms the missing paper-level pair only; its overall outcome has not been adjudicated.
